description: Java class implementing a rule node for handling telemetry time series data in Thingsboard, including processing strategies, message handling, and configuration upgrade logic.

classes.name: TbMsgTimeseriesNode
classes.description: Implements a rule node for saving telemetry time series data with configurable processing strategies, TTL, and message handling logic.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the node with context and configuration, sets up tenant profile listener, and loads processing settings.

methods.name: onTenantProfileUpdate
methods.description: Updates default storage TTL based on tenant profile configuration.

methods.name: onMsg
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, processes telemetry data, and triggers save operations based on strategies.

methods.name: computeTs
methods.description: Computes timestamp for message, optionally ignoring metadata timestamp.

methods.name: determineSaveStrategy
methods.description: Determines the save strategy for telemetry data based on processing settings and message timestamp.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes listeners and cleans up resources.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Handles configuration upgrades from older versions.
